target_rows.label: Aggregate net wealth / annual gross labor earnings
target_rows.sample: Pooled PSID survey waves 2005 and 2007. Numerator: reference persons ages 18-85 with RELTOHEAD=10, positive finite IW, finite NETWORTHR (11,324 family-years / 6,349 persons). Denominator: ages 18-65 with positive finite IW and finite nonnegative reference-person-plus-spouse gross labor earnings EARNINDRRC (9,750 family-years / 5,521 persons).
target_rows.definition: Ratio of pooled weighted totals: sum(IW*NETWORTHR) among reference persons ages18-85 / sum(IW*EARNINDRRC) among reference persons ages18-65; not total family income and not a mean of household ratios.
target_rows.uncertainty_status: Person-ID cluster bootstrap, 999 draws, seed 20260723; dates label PSID survey waves, with detailed within-wave valuation and earnings reference-year metadata inherited from the shelf.
target_rows.weight_status: unchanged inherited positive calibration weight 7.595098472533724; distinct from updated 2005/2007 bootstrap SE (the old 2003/2005 SE is stale).
target_rows.mapping_warning: Household net worth is scaled by reference-person-plus-spouse gross labor earnings; calendar-specific wealth valuation and earnings-reference-year alignment remains inherited from the PSID shelf and is not newly certified.

target_rows.label: Annual bequests / aggregate wealth

source.contract_id: author-adopted target for next calibration; verified SCF calculation receipt
source.builder: No checked-in executable builder was retained. Calculation is documented in calculation/verified_receipt.json, calculation/published_method_reconciliation.json, inputs.json, and saved scenario tables; inputs are official 2007 SCF public microdata and 2007 life-table mortality.

target_rows.sample: 2007 SCF; mortality-weighted positive NETWORTH-TRUSTS estate proxy, with qx95 mapping for public ages top-coded at 95; scenario allocates 25% child share for legal marriage and 75% otherwise; aggregate signed NETWORTH denominator.
target_rows.definition: Annual child-directed bequest-flow proxy divided by aggregate signed SCF NETWORTH: $674.4895 billion / $92.5096 trillion in 2022 dollars = 0.007291023472616158.
target_rows.uncertainty_status: inherited synthetic five-percent calibration scale; NOT a standard error
target_rows.mapping_warning: Experimental approximation: the frozen model observer sums positive estates over all fertility/dependent-child states without child-recipient eligibility or allocation, whereas the adopted SCF ratio is child-directed. No recipient-law change is authorized in this contract.

target_rows.label: Old wealth/income p90 / median, ages 76–84
target_rows.sample: Living PSID reference persons ages 76-84, relation_to_head=10, positive IW, completed children observed, INCFAMR>1000; p90/p50 of NETWORTHR/INCFAMR; 2003-2005; 644 valid family-years/416 IDs; bootstrap population 918 living reference IDs ages 65-84, before outcome/children filters.
target_rows.mapping_warning: Uniform within-age-cell overlap for ages 76--84 Modeled pension plus configured lump-sum income proxy; not PSID total family income Empirical $1000 real-income and observed-child-history filters are not reproduced At these retirement ages model denominator is pension income (including configured z scaling), while PSID INCFAMR also includes transfers, asset income and other family components. Exact $1000 cutoff is not applied (only income>0), and observed-completed-children selection has no model missingness counterpart. Full 78/82 cells do not cover exactly 76-84. Actual model property-tax lump-sum transfer is zero in this receipt; proxy uses the configured pension-plus-transfer concept.
